offer: Appointment software for independent physiotherapy clinics
audience: UK clinic owners evaluating appointment software

baseline.metric: Qualified demo requests from organic visitors
baseline.limitation: No authorized analytics or Search Console data was available for a comparable history.

findings.observation: The clinic page describes scheduling but does not explain how patient reminders work.
The homepage has a demo link; the owner has not confirmed whether a demo request is tracked.

priorities.action: Draft a reviewed reminder explanation on the clinic page after confirming the product claim.
priorities.success_signal: Approved explanation is published; visits and qualified demo requests are tracked from the agreed start date.
priorities.rank_reason: The named buyer cannot find an answer on a relevant offer page; source evidence is directly observed.

priorities.action: Confirm and test the demo-request event definition.
priorities.success_signal: A test request appears once in the authorized analytics or CRM source.
priorities.rank_reason: The goal cannot be measured reliably until the event is confirmed.

unknowns: Whether reminders are available on every product plan
Whether a demo-request event already exists
limitations: Only two public pages were inspected; search demand and indexing are unknown.
